# Document compatibility fixtures

These files are frozen outputs of Terra's production `TerrainDocument::to_json`
writer. They are intentionally not regenerated by the test suite and must not be
hand-edited into a newer schema.

| Fixture | Writer commit | SHA-256 | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `document_v2_b450e72.json` | `b450e72` | `17B784E83070239D97CE42F97EE3C691EB59D9BF6460D2E8F2789ACF1FB056DA` | Original version-2 writer. |
| `document_v1_8587974.json` | `8587974baa3b6ff04ebad3233105d1f609f0e96d` | `8A307ED1ED99F56408D2186266905F88CCAA7851E7C10ACE7CD0036EC9237CB1` | Version 1 after the authoring/schema rewrite. |
| `document_v1_7b336c4.json` | `7b336c4` | `52569EE8A0B495A6DDBC8EE48F7CA669C0FD9DCD6DF0BD2E862B2648C934DB82` | Later version-1 writer at the D1 audit point. |
| `document_v1_null_height_bounds_7b336c4.json` | `7b336c4` | `87310C1E610D5D135DB770823DC884CD4FA0EFC99156FD511376541C7C66EAC2` | Captures required material/biome bounds emitted as `null`. |
| `document_v2_e4ea27f_full.json` | `e4ea27f157ab465fdacd1d559d3e6005e25e49df` | `3991AD6CF8C14133A1C22F54065CCB7F0382DC116309D1542FD8CBD9838E23BA` | Current full-feature fixture after the finite-bound repair. |

The two issue-71 fixtures were generated in detached worktrees at the listed
commits with temporary Rust examples. The examples used only production model
constructors and `TerrainDocument::to_json`, assigned stable authored UUIDs, and
reduced sculpt buffers before serialization. The emitted JSON bytes were copied
unchanged; the temporary examples and worktrees were then removed.
